49113-is-the-vicar-of-brompton-a-tractar.title: A Question For The Parishioners.
49113-is-the-vicar-of-brompton-a-tractar.creator: A Layman.
49113-is-the-vicar-of-brompton-a-tractar.description: A book by A Layman.. st the “Tractarians” to keep aloof in some measure from the “Ultras” of their party, and to follow the Jesuitical advice given from a certain quarter, not to be over hasty in bringing in Anglican forms and observances amongst their congregations, but to win them over by little and little.

77509-bill-of-the-wild-streak.title: Bill Of The Wild Streak
77509-bill-of-the-wild-streak.creator: Howard E. Morgan
77509-bill-of-the-wild-streak.description: A book by Howard E. Morgan. Bill was a mongrel, a splendid mixture of at least four fine strains; his mother was a sled dog from the Yukon, part chow, part Ungava husky with a dash of wolf blood running strongly near the surface; his father was a collie with an interbreeding of mastiff.

arxiv-2108-11472.title: Bandwidth Allocation and Service Differentiation in D2D Wireless Networks
arxiv-2108-11472.creator: François Baccelli and Sanket S. Kalamkar
arxiv-2108-11472.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by François Baccelli and Sanket S. Kalamkar. Inspired by a new feature in 5G NR called bandwidth part (BWP), this paper presents a bandwidth allocation (BA) model that allows one to adapt the bandwidth allocated to users depending on their data rate needs. Specifically, in adaptive BA, a wide bandwidth is divided into chunks of smaller bandwidths and the number of bandwidth chunks allocated to a user depends on its needs or type.

arxiv-2206-04538.title: Non-minimal coupling of scalar and gauge fields with gravity: an entropy current and linearized second law
arxiv-2206-04538.creator: Parthajit Biswas, Prateksh Dhivakar, and Nilay Kundu
arxiv-2206-04538.description: Abstract This work extends the proof of a local version of the linearized second law involving an entropy current with non-negative divergence by including the arbitrary non-minimal coupling of scalar and U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) gauge fields with gravity.

arxiv-2305-09023.title: Continuum-wise hyperbolic homeomorphisms on surfaces Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification : Primary 37B45; Secondary 37D10.
arxiv-2305-09023.creator: Rodrigo Arruda, Bernardo Carvalho, Alberto Sarmiento
arxiv-2305-09023.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Rodrigo Arruda, Bernardo Carvalho, Alberto Sarmiento. This paper discusses the dynamics of continuum-wise hyperbolic surface homeomorphisms. We prove that c ​ w F cw_{F} -hyperbolic surface homeomorphisms containing only a finite set of spines are c ​ w 2 cw_{2} -hyperbolic. In the case of c ​ w 3 cw_{3} -hyperbolic homeomorphisms we prove the finiteness of spines and, hence, that c ​ w 3 cw_{3} -hyperbolicity implies c ​ w 2 cw_{2} -hyperbolicity.

arxiv-2311-14817.title: Quantifying edge relevance for epidemic spreading via the semi-metric topology of complex networks
arxiv-2311-14817.creator: David Soriano-Paños, Felipe Xavier Costa, Luis M. Rocha
arxiv-2311-14817.description: Abstract Sparsification aims at extracting a reduced core of associations that best preserves both the dynamics and topology of networks while reducing the computational cost of simulations. We show that the semi-metric topology of complex networks yields a natural and algebraically-principled sparsification that outperforms existing methods on those goals.

arxiv-2402-04327.title: On the estimation and interpretation
arxiv-2402-04327.creator: of effect size metrics
arxiv-2402-04327.description: Abstract Effect size estimates are thought to capture the collective, two-way response to an intervention or exposure in a three-way problem among the intervention/exposure, various confounders and the outcome. For meaningful causal inference from the estimated effect size, the joint distribution of observed confounders must be identical across all intervention/exposure groups.

arxiv-2510-14928.title: Instruction Set Migration at Warehouse Scale
arxiv-2510-14928.creator: Eric Christopher, Kevin Crossan, Wolff Dobson, Chris Kennelly, Drew Lewis, Kun Lin, Martin Maas, Parthasarathy Ranganathan, Emma Rapati, Brian Yang
arxiv-2510-14928.description: Abstract . Migrating codebases from one instruction set architecture (ISA) to another is a major engineering challenge. A recent example is the adoption of Arm (in addition to x86) across the major Cloud hyperscalers. Yet, this problem has seen limited attention by the academic community.

arxiv-2511-11997.title: Imitation Learning with Safety and L 2 L^{2} Stability Certificates for Boundary Control of Reaction–Diffusion PDEs
arxiv-2511-11997.creator: Paulo Henrique F. Biazetto, Mirko Fiacchini, Christophe Prieur, Gustavo Artur de Andrade
arxiv-2511-11997.description: Abstract This paper proposes an imitation learning (IL) framework for synthesizing neural network (NN) controllers that achieve boundary stabilization of systems governed by reaction–diffusion partial differential equations (PDEs). The plant is assumed to be actuated through a Dirichlet boundary condition and subject to a Neumann condition on the unactuated side.

arxiv-2601-18327.title: Scalable Repeater Architecture for Long-Range Quantum Energy Teleportation in Gapped Systems
arxiv-2601-18327.creator: M. Y. Abd-Rabbou, Irfan Siddique, Saeed Haddadi, Cong‑Feng Qiao
arxiv-2601-18327.description: Abstract Quantum Energy Teleportation (QET) constitutes a paradigm-shifting protocol that permits the activation of local vacuum energy through the consumption of pre-existing entanglement and classical communication. Nevertheless, the implementation of QET is severely impeded by the fundamental locality of gapped many-body systems, where the exponential clustering of ground-state correlations restricts energy extraction to microscopic scales.

plos-pone-0005029.creator: Xiaochun Fan, Kevin Struhl
plos-pone-0005029.description: PLOS ONE research article. The Mediator complex associates with RNA polymerase (Pol) II, and it is recruited to enhancer regions by activator proteins under appropriate environmental conditions. However, the issue of Mediator association in yeast cells is controversial. Under optimal growth conditions (YPD

pmc-11415832.title: A case of thoracic epidural angiolipoma: CT and MRI findings
pmc-11415832.creator: Kosuke Fujioka, Yoshiaki Katada, Kentaro Mataki, Toshinori Tsukanishi, Tomoo Ishii, Yukio Morishita, Shinji Sugahara
pmc-11415832.description: Spinal angiolipomas are rare benign tumors composed of mature adipose cells and blood vessel walls. We report the case of a patient with a spinal epidural angiolipoma who presented with paraplegia and was treated by urgent tumor resection and decompression.

pmc-11425545.title: S07 Public green spaces as sustainable environments for inclusive HEPA
pmc-11425545.creator: Karim Abu-Omar, Antonina Tcymbal
pmc-11425545.description: As urban populations around the world continue to grow, the push to transform our cities into greener, more sustainable, and healthier places is gaining momentum. In this context, it is widely recognized that different characteristics of public green spaces influence who accesses them, and how active people are in them.

pmc-11517877.title: Working in emergency services in Germany: cross-sectional data on violence experience and perception
pmc-11517877.creator: A Zhelyazkova, M Bonigut
pmc-11517877.description: BackgroundViolence in emergency medical services (EMS) continues to be a topic of concern. Experiencing violence impedes the workers’ wellbeing, thus impairing the coverage and quality of EMS. We explored employment-related factors associated with violence experience and perception.MethodsWe conducted an anonymous online-based survey among EMS staff in Germany (09.2023-01.2024).

pmc-11521212.title: Solitary Hybrid Neurofibroma–Schwannoma of the Brachial Plexus in a 4-Year-Old Child
pmc-11521212.creator: Varunkumar Maddileti
pmc-11521212.description: We report the case of a 4-year-old child with a rare solitary neurofibroma–schwannoma hybrid tumor in the brachial plexus, not associated with known syndromes. Surgical management through a transclavicular approach enabled complete tumor excision with favorable postoperative outcomes. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed the tumor’s hybrid nature.

pmc-11570795.title: Collaborative dynamics and shared motivation: exploring tobacco control policy development in Zambia
pmc-11570795.creator: Adam Silumbwe, Miguel San Sebastian, Joseph Mumba Zulu, Charles Michelo, Klara Johansson
pmc-11570795.description: In Zambia, efforts to produce a tobacco control policy have stalled for over a decade, and the country is not yet close to developing one. Limited studies have explored the dynamics in this policy process and how they affect the attainment of policy goals and outcomes.

pmc-11642496.title: The Coloring Mechanism of Opaque Glazes from the Changsha Kiln of the Tang Dynasty
pmc-11642496.creator: Lala Jia, Maolin Zhang, Yongqiang Yu, Zihan Li, Yongbin Yu, Mario J Muñoz Batista, Ana Isabel Calero-Castillo
pmc-11642496.description: The Changsha Kiln of the Tang Dynasty was a major site for celadon production, yet the mechanisms behind the unique coloring of its opaque glazes remain inadequately explored. Prior research has largely focused on the general composition of these glazes, with limited understanding of the specific processes contributing to their distinct visual characteristics.

pmc-11714768.title: Data‐driven analysis of 10,361 amyloid‐PET scans from the IDEAS study reveals two primary axes of variation
pmc-11714768.creator: Joseph Giorgio, Nidhi S Mundada, Ganna Blazhenets, Jhony Alejandro Mejía‐Perez, Daniel R. Schonhaut, Maria C. Carrillo, Lucy Hanna, Constantine Gatsonis, Andrew March, Charles Apgar, Barry A. Siegel, Bruce E Hillner, Rachel A. Whitmer, William J. Jagust, Gil D. Rabinovici, Renaud La Joie
pmc-11714768.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe variability in the regional distribution of Aβ‐PET signal and its relation to clinical features is debated. We used data‐driven approaches to uncover heterogeneity in cortical Aβ‐PET signal from a large representative sample collected through the IDEAS study.MethodsWe analysed cross‐sectional Aβ‐PET collected from 10,361 patients with MCI or mild dementia scanned in 295 PET facilities using one of the 3 FDA‐approved tracers. Central image processing resulted in template‐space SUVR images (reference: whole cerebellum) and centiloid (CL) values.

pmc-12397234.title: Association of serum osmolality levels with all-cause mortality risk in patients with DKA
pmc-12397234.creator: Jian Liao, Dingyu Lu, Zhi Liang, Hongwei Tan, Maojuan Wang
pmc-12397234.description: The purpose of this study was to investigate the relationship. between serum osmolality levels and 28-day mortality in patients with DKA. Data for this observational cohort study were obtained from the MIMIC-IV3.0 database. The participants were divided into five groups based on the serum osmolality quintiles. The primary outcome was 28-day mortality.

pmc-12525637.title: Short-Term Efficacy of Two-Step Treatment of Retinopathy of Prematurity in a Japanese Cohort: Anti-VEGF Therapy Followed by Routine Laser Photocoagulation
pmc-12525637.creator: Shimpei Oba, Tatsunori Kiriishi, Masatoshi Omi, Yuki Hattori, Hidetsugu Mori, Masayuki Ohnaka, Takeshi Hoshino, Haruhiko Yamada, Hisanori Imai
pmc-12525637.description: Objective: The aim of this study was to assess the efficacy of laser photocoagulation (LPC) combined with anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), in comparison with routine LPC monotherapy, in the treatment of retinopathy of prematurity (ROP). Methods: This retrospective study included data from 142 eyes treated according to the standard criteria of the Early Treatment for Retinopathy of Prematurity (ETROP).

pmc-12653448.title: Effects of Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation Circuits on Drug Sequestration: A Review of Ex Vivo Experiments
pmc-12653448.creator: Stéphane Bertin, David Haefliger, Antoine G. Schneider, Raphaël Giraud, Maria-Helena Perez, Xavier Bechtold, Ermindo R. Di Paolo, Laura E. Rothuizen, Thierry Buclin, Françoise Livio
pmc-12653448.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) can affect the disposition of drugs, notably by sequestering them in a circuit. This review aimed to provide a comprehensive summary of existing ex vivo studies investigating the impact of contemporary ECMO circuits on drug sequestration, and to examine the associations between the physicochemical properties of drugs, the features and settings of ECMO devices, and the extent of drug sequestration.

pmc-12694863.title: Emergency department visits for ambulatory care sensitive conditions by persons with Rheumatoid Arthritis: A population-based study
pmc-12694863.creator: Dani G. Contreras, Zanir Bhanji, J. Antonio Aviña-Zubieta, Claire E.H. Barber, Cheryl Barnabe
pmc-12694863.description: PurposeWe estimated emergency department (ED) visit rates for Canadian-indicator Ambulatory Care Sensitive Conditions (ACSCs) by persons with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) relative to age- and sex-matched general population controls.MethodsCases were identified using a validated definition based on International Classification of Diseases codes (years 2002–2023).

pmc-12723219.title: School masking and COVID-19 community transmission: a synthetic control study
pmc-12723219.creator: Xianqun Luan, Brian T Fisher, Susan E Coffin, David Rubin, Meredith Matone, Jing Huang
pmc-12723219.description: IntroductionK-12 schools are not only educational settings but also hubs of social interaction, making them potential drivers of disease transmission within households and communities. While many existing studies have assessed school masking in relation to in-school transmission, the broader community impact of mandatory school masking policies on SARS-CoV-2 infection rates remains poorly understood.

pmc-12768834.title: PD60 Leveraging Real-World Evidence For Rare Disease And Oncology Health Technology Assessments: Insights From Pulse Infoframe Inc.’s Hybrid Approach
pmc-12768834.creator: Daniel Lewi, Femida Gwadry-Sridhar
pmc-12768834.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionHealth technology assessment (HTA) of rare diseases and cancer face significant challenges in illustrating value. This is compounded by small patient populations, limited data, and undefined endpoints. pmc-13087183.title: Fabrication of a ZGTPM nanocomposite membrane for the synergistic removal of tetracycline via size selective sieving and photocatalytic degradation
pmc-13087183.creator: Ayman K. El-Sawaf, Amal A. Nassar, Gehan A. Hammouda, A. Ebada, Rania Elshypany, Mahmoud F. M.
pmc-13087183.description: This study synthesized a multifunctional ZGTPM nanocomposite membrane (ZIF-8/graphene oxide/Ti₃C₂ MXene/TiO₂ photocatalytic membrane), which combined ZIF-8 (zeolitic imidazolate framework 8), graphene oxide (GO), Ti₃C₂ MXene (two dimensional transition metal carbide), and TiO₂ quantum dots, for the ultraeffective removal of tetracycline (TC) from polluted water. Comprehensive characterization confirmed the formation of TiO₂ quantum dots (3–5 nm) which enhanced membrane properties.

pmc-13430480.title: Thiamine deficiency observed in family caregivers of AYA cancer patients
pmc-13430480.creator: Hideki Onishi, Maho Ishikawa, Yoshitaka Ooya, Nozomu Uchida, Akira Yoshioka, Izumi Sato, Mayumi Ishida
